inputs.Surv_A: bounded by the survivor cap (term survivor_gates_cap): at most cap x shards x 8 records
inputs.Surv_G: bounded by the survivor cap (term survivor_gates_cap): at most cap x shards x 8 records

C7.per_record_seconds_note: central: the record-weighted mean over the context-size histogram; upper_at_m_max: at the largest context size

sets.1_Surv: within survivor_gates_cap (every survivor record of a gated orbit; beyond the cap the run is INCOMPLETE)
sets.2_set2_G: |F_G| x c7_G (the part of set 2 outside Surv_G is within F_G)
sets.3_I_and_H100: (|I_A| / 100) x c7_A + (|I_G| / 100) x c7_G (expected sample sizes)

cost.ceiling_status: owner-fixed ceiling, all run overhead included

formulas.C7_scope: |F_G| x c7_G + (|I_A|/100) x c7_A + (|I_G|/100) x c7_G + (N/1000) x (c7_A + c7_G), with c7_c = 2 x [t_c(m) + r_c(m)] per record (direct production closure and full s0ref reference, normal and -O); set 1 is in survivor_gates_cap
formulas.closures: 2 x overhead x sum_m count(m) x (orbits/N) x 2 [t_A(m) + t_G(m)]; overhead = 2 is an unmeasured judgement (design/overhead/ reports a local measurement)
formulas.s1a: 2 x [2 (t_A + t_G)(|U|) + 3 streams x 2 rules x (r_A + r_G)(m_cal) x |U| / m_cal + sum_lines (t_A + t_G)(m_line)]
formulas.sampled_gates: 2 x [(1/R_C11i + 1/R_C17 + 1/R_C18) x orbits x (r_A + r_G)(m_mean) + (1/R_C8) x orbits x 8 x 2 (t_A + t_G)(m_mean)]
formulas.survivor_gates_cap: 2 x cap x shards x 8 x [2 (t_A + t_G) + 4 (r_A + r_G)](m_max), which includes C7 on set 1; cap is owner-set for v8

cost.kappa: not fixed (method approved: u_cal x u_model)

kappa_rule.method: kappa = u_cal x u_model, rounded up to one decimal; fixed before any v8 count

cost.launch_decision: not decided: kappa, reserve not available
launch_not_decided_because: kappa is not fixed: u_cal or u_model is an OWNER placeholder (method approved, no value)
the reserve is an OWNER placeholder; no default exists
cost.launch_rule: launch iff kappa x total + reserve <= ceiling (24 runner-hours, everything included) and kappa x each job <= its timeout; otherwise not undertaken for cost (a new reviewed design, or infeasible under this budget); kappa is never lowered to fit

overhead_factor.status: unmeasured judgement; local measurement reported in design/overhead/
